text_en: So I made up my mind not to make you another painful visit.
text_cn: 所以我拿定了主意，不再带忧苦到你们那里去，

text_en: For if I cause you pain, who is there to make me glad but the one whom I have pained?
text_cn: 因为如果我使你们忧苦，那么，除了那由我而受忧苦的人外，又有谁可使我欢乐呢？

text_en: And I wrote as I did, so that when I came, I might not suffer pain from those who should have made me rejoice; for I am confident about all of you, that my joy would be the joy of all of you.
text_cn: 为此，我写了那样的信，正是为避免我来到的时候，那本该叫我喜乐的，反而叫我忧苦，因为我相信你们众人都以我的喜乐为你们众人的喜乐。

text_en: For I wrote you out of much distress and anguish of heart and with many tears, not to cause you pain, but to let you know the abundant love that I have for you.
text_cn: 我在万般的痛心忧苦中，流着许多泪给你们写了信，并不是为叫你们忧苦，而是为叫你们认清我对你们所有的爱，多么卓绝。

text_en: But if anyone has caused pain, he has caused it not to me, but to some extent—not to exaggerate it—to all of you.
text_cn: 如果有人使人忧苦，他不是使我忧苦，而是使你们众人，至少使一部分，免得我说得过火。

text_en: This punishment by the majority is enough for such a person;
text_cn: 这样的人，受了你们大多数人的谴责，已足够了；

text_en: so now instead you should forgive and console him, so that he may not be overwhelmed by excessive sorrow.
text_cn: 你们宽恕劝慰他，反倒更好，免得他一时为过度的忧苦所吞噬。

text_en: So I urge you to reaffirm your love for him.
text_cn: 为此，我劝告你们对他再建起爱情来。

text_en: I wrote for this reason: to test you and to know whether you are obedient in everything.
text_cn: 其实，也正是为此我才写了那信，为要考验你们，看你们是否在一切事上都服从命令。

text_en: Anyone whom you forgive, I also forgive. What I have forgiven, if I have forgiven anything, has been for your sake in the presence of Christ.
text_cn: 你们宽恕谁什么，我也宽恕，因为我所宽恕的──如果我曾宽恕过什么──是为你们的缘故，当着基督的面而宽恕的，

text_en: And we do this so that we may not be outwitted by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his designs.
text_cn: 免得我们让撒殚占了便宜，因为我们不是不知道他的心意。

text_en: When I came to Troas to proclaim the good news of Christ, a door was opened for me in the Lord;
text_cn: 当我为宣讲基督福音来到特洛阿时，虽然给我开了为主工作的大门，

text_en: but my mind could not rest because I did not find my brother Titus there. So I said farewell to them and went on to Macedonia.
text_cn: 但因我没有遇到我的弟兄弟铎，我的心神得不到安宁，遂辞别他们，到马其顿去了。

text_en: But thanks be to God, who in Christ always leads us in triumphal procession, and through us spreads in every place the fragrance that comes from knowing him.
text_cn: 感谢天主时常使我们在基督内参与凯旋的行列，并藉我们在各处播扬认识基督的芬芳；

text_en: For we are the aroma of Christ to God among those who are being saved and among those who are perishing;
text_cn: 因为我们就是献与天主的基督的馨香，在得救的人中是，在丧亡的人中也是；

text_en: to the one a fragrance from death to death, to the other a fragrance from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?
text_cn: 但为后者，是由死入死的芬芳；为前者，却是由生入生的芬芳。对这样的工作，谁够资格呢？

text_en: For we are not peddlers of God’s word like so many; but in Christ we speak as persons of sincerity, as persons sent from God and standing in his presence.
text_cn: 至少我们不像那许多人为利而混乱了天主的道理；我们宣讲乃是出于真诚，出于天主，当着天主的面，在基督内。
